## Search The Collection

The `collection search` command
allows searching for artists, albums, tracks, and playlists.

For the sake of clarity, the following examples
issue the `--limit 5` option to show only the top five results.
Omit it if you want the full list.

Moreover, the `--print-uri` option is present,
so that the URI of the artist/album/track/playlist is printed,
as it can be used to replace the current queue with it.

### List Artists Matching A Query

```bash
volumito collection search --print-uri --artist "The Beatles" --artists-only --limit 5
Volumio Search Results
==================================================

QOBUZ Artists
1. The Beatles
   qobuz://artist/26390
2. The Beatles Revival Band
   qobuz://artist/972325
3. The Beatles The Beatles
   qobuz://artist/11334236
4. The Beatles Tribute Band
   qobuz://artist/2741971
5. The Beatles Tribute Project
   qobuz://artist/2749534
```

### List Albums Of An Artist

```bash
volumito collection search --print-uri --artist "The Beatles" --albums-only --limit 5
Volumio Search Results
==================================================

QOBUZ Albums
1. Abbey Road - The Beatles
   qobuz://album/trrcz9pvaaz6b
2. The Beatles 1962 – 1966 - The Beatles
   qobuz://album/sixjslxc22vhb
3. The Beatles - The Beatles
   qobuz://album/0060254767017
4. Rubber Soul - The Beatles
   qobuz://album/0060254767015
5. Revolver - The Beatles
   qobuz://album/h37m83cfcns7b
```

### List Tracks Of An Artist

```bash
volumito collection search --print-uri --artist "The Beatles" --tracks-only --limit 5
Volumio Search Results
==================================================

QOBUZ Tracks
1. Come Together - The Beatles - Abbey Road
   qobuz://song/64868955
2. Here Comes The Sun - The Beatles - Abbey Road
   qobuz://song/64868961
3. Something - The Beatles - Abbey Road
   qobuz://song/64868956
4. While My Guitar Gently Weeps - The Beatles - The Beatles (White Album) [Super Deluxe]
   qobuz://song/53668085
5. Eleanor Rigby - The Beatles - Revolver
   qobuz://song/172443631
```

### List Qobuz Playlists Of An Artist

You can filter by service provider, in this case `--service qobuz` for Qobuz.

```bash
volumito collection search --print-uri --artist "The Beatles" --playlists-only --service qobuz --limit 5
Volumio Search Results
==================================================

QOBUZ Playlists
1. The Beatles
   qobuz://playlist/1902255
2. Hi-Res Masters: The Beatles
   qobuz://playlist/18015824
3. The Beatles, visti dagli altri...
   qobuz://playlist/1796552
4. The Beatles Love Songs
   qobuz://playlist/8845774
5. The Beatles Breakup Songs
   qobuz://playlist/3117168
```

### List Local Albums Of An Artist

```bash
volumito collection search --print-uri --artist "Mango" --albums-only --service mpd --limit 5
Volumio Search Results
==================================================

MPD Albums
1. Disincanto - Mango
   albums://Mango/Disincanto
2. Sirtaki - Mango
   albums://Mango/Sirtaki
```

Local files are identified by `--service mpd`.

### List All Resources Of An Artist

If you want to search across all services and all resources,
just omit the `--*-only` and `--service` options.
For example, for artist "Enrico Ruggeri",
both local and Qobuz resources are available:

```bash
volumito collection search --artist "Enrico Ruggeri" --print-uri --limit 5
```

### Replace The Current Queue (Search)

You can use the URI of a result to replace
the current queue with it, and start playing it right away.

For example, to play the album "The Beatles 1962 – 1966 - The Beatles":

```bash
volumito queue replace "qobuz://album/sixjslxc22vhb"
{
    "album": "The Beatles 1962 – 1966",
    "artist": "The Beatles",
    "bitdepth": "24 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:02:26",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "96 kHz",
    "seek": "00:00:01.000",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Love Me Do",
    "trackType": "qobuz",
    "volume": 20
}
[2026-08-13T08:49:34.628Z] [INFO] Command 'replace' executed successfully
```

To play just the song "Here Comes The Sun - The Beatles - Abbey Road":

```bash
volumito queue replace "qobuz://song/64868961"
{
    "album": "Abbey Road",
    "artist": "The Beatles",
    "bitdepth": "24 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:03:06",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "96 kHz",
    "seek": "00:00:00.137",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Here Comes The Sun",
    "trackType": "qobuz",
    "volume": 20
}
[2026-08-13T08:49:37.718Z] [INFO] Command 'replace' executed successfully
```

```bash
volumito queue list
[
    {
        "album": "Abbey Road",
        "artist": "The Beatles",
        "duration": "00:03:05",
        "position": 1,
        "title": "Here Comes The Sun",
        "tracknumber": 7,
        "volumeNumber": 1
    }
]
```

Local files work as well:

```bash
volumito queue replace "albums://Mango/Sirtaki"
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:06:59",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",

    "status": "play",
    "title": "1 - Nella mia città",
    "trackType": "flac",

}
```
